name: TUNKHANNOCK 14-POINT PITCH
description: Tunkhannock 14-point Pitch is a Pennsylvania cutthroat or partnership Pitch variant using a 54-card deck (52 plus two jokers). Six cards each, then bid 3 to 15 (smudge); after bidding, discard three and replenish. Off-jack and jokers rank as trumps below the jack. Fourteen points (high, low, jack, off-jack, jokers, game, last trick, high spade, five) to win.

content.text: Tunkhannock 14-point Pitch is a Pennsylvania cutthroat or partnership Pitch variant using a 54-card deck (52 plus two jokers). Six cards each, then bid 3 to 15 (smudge); after bidding, discard three and replenish. Off-jack and jokers rank as trumps below the jack. Fourteen points (high, low, jack, off-jack, jokers, game, last trick, high spade, five) to win.

Tunkhannock 14-point Pitch is a Pennsylvania regional variant of Pitch, related to Oklahoma 10-point Pitch. It is documented as normally played cutthroat by four players but can also be played in partnership. The game takes its name from the Tunkhannock region; detailed rules were preserved on Bill and Joe's archived 14 point Tunkhannock Pitch page (2000).

Each player receives six cards, dealt three at a time (two rounds of three). After the bidding round, each player discards three cards face down and the dealer replenishes their hand to six cards from the undealt stock. Deal rotates clockwise after each hand.
